dedupe_keys.name: verrijkte bag enriched dutch building register for local energy questions utility buildings

description: The Verrijkte BAG adds energy-relevant information to the Dutch register of buildings and addresses for non-residential utility buildings, so that local energy questions and existing models can use more public data. TNO, working for the Netherlands Enterprise Agency, gave each utility building an indicative energy label and indicative electricity, gas or heat use, and used building geometry to compute floor, roof and facade areas, including the share of facade shared with neighbours and the share exposed to outdoor air and so open to insulation. There are two files, one per addressable object and one aggregated to buildings, with an Excel list of almost 140 variables and a report on the method. Coverage: utility buildings across the Netherlands. Access: free zipped files from TNO, listed on data.overheid.nl and energy.nl. Licence: recorded as unknown on data.overheid.nl. Caveats: labels and energy use are modelled indications, not metered values; a follow-up was planned to split the 11 BAG use classes into types such as data centres, cold stores and pools. Simulation uses are municipal heat transition and insulation scenarios and non-residential energy demand baselines. Related records: the BAG, 3D BAG and EP-Online energy labels.
